limits: No PDF, image, Office or audio content parsing; full-text search covers only already-read notice body and assignment instructions. A truncated body is marked body_truncated and full-text search returns PARTIAL.
A notice without an attachment does not become a resource entry, so its body is not separately searchable.
Default reuse trusts a saved file with matching hash; same-version content change requires verify_known=True or a new source version.
The index is a bounded, in-memory-decrypted document (4 MiB, 2000 entries per semester), not an incremental full-text engine.
One writer per account and semester is assumed; the 2.2 store lock protects writes but the last write wins on concurrent read-modify-write.
Plans are process-local, expire after 10 minutes, are single-use and are capped at 20 pending plans; a restart requires a new preview.
STALE entries require allow_historical=True; MISSING entries require include_superseded=True.
Archive writes use an atomic hard-link publish where supported and a checked replace fallback otherwise; a single writer per destination is assumed.
Preview hashes existing files within a 512 MiB budget; when the budget is exhausted the item is REVIEW_EXISTING and is not overwritten.
The current source interface does not provide a reliable page URL, so source_link remains null and the export states source_link_state=NOT_AVAILABLE_IN_THIS_VERSION.
The module is not registered in queries.py, MCP or CLI; 6.1 owns the public facade and resource error-code registration.
This result is synthetic engineering evidence only; it does not prove a real campus read or download.

cross_module_requests.request: Register the remaining RESOURCE_* codes in contracts/v0.2/error-classification.json (AUTH_REQUIRED and FORBIDDEN already exist); expose ResourceCenter only, not Archive/Index; use the INDEX account scope for the index and the MEDIA account scope for media registration.
Use stable_resource_uid and public fields only; do not read archive-relative paths or download directories. A resource reference is not local file read permission.
If the installed layout ships module docs, add resources/README.md to package-data; tests/synthetic_resources.py must not be packaged; no new runtime dependency is required.

Include tests/test_resources.py in cross-platform regression. P1-10 removed the POSIX-only test destination; Windows execution of hard-link publish, os.replace fallback and reserved device-name cases is still required.

Reconcile learn:FILE:<source record id> (frozen stability sample, used here) with domain_models.resource_uid producing learn:RESOURCE:<id>, so 4.2 and other adapters do not publish two stable identities.

rollback: Stop calling ResourceCenter; delete_cache(semester) atomically replaces the encrypted index with an empty record. Downloaded files and the user directory are untouched; the existing Learn course file list and download entry remain available. Do not convert the index to plaintext or bulk-delete archive directories.
